handovers.error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '<repo>\node_modules\electron-updater\out\NsisUpdater.js'
handovers.summary: Fails on untouched main: ENOENT on node_modules/electron-updater/out/NsisUpdater.js. The test reaches into electron-updater's internals and that file is not present in this checkout's dependency tree.
handovers.detail: This is a dependency/environment gap rather than a product fault, but unlike the ACL one it may be fixable by installing or repairing electron-updater. Not touching node_modules — the charter forbids it and a partial repair is worse than a recorded gap.

resolution.note: Withdrawn as not reproducing. Re-verified on 2026-09-16 at commit 2d6dce36: tests/private-update-feed.test.mjs passes 24/24, and require.resolve from this worktree correctly walks up to the shared node_modules at the repo root. The original ENOENT named a worktree-local node_modules path that does not exist, so this was an environment artifact of the moment it was measured, not a property of main. Not handed to anyone.

handovers.summary: FLAKY on untouched main: presentfocus.test.tsx alternates between its §5 and §6 cases across runs — one full run failed §5 and passed it on retry, the next failed §6 and passed IT on retry.
handovers.detail: This is the one of the three that looks like a real product defect rather than an environment property. The tool's confirmation pass marks it flaky rather than a stable known failure, which means compare() will not quietly excuse a genuine regression in that file. Worth an owner.

resolution.note: Withdrawn as not reproducing in the latest full run: the renderer suite recorded 2091/2091 with zero failures at commit 2d6dce36. The flakiness is real and was observed across four earlier runs (alternating between the §5 and §6 cases, passing both on retry), but it is not currently failing, so there is nothing to hand over today. Left here as a record that the file is unstable rather than as an open request.
